workflowInput.requestedWork: Train prompt-only style reconstruction: use target truth for analysis and judging only, and generate every candidate, validation case, and test case from the source image plus reconstructed text prompt without a style-reference image.
acceptanceCriteria: The final prompt is self-contained text and requires no target or style-reference image at generation time.
Every candidate, validation, and test generation record contains exactly one source_reference image input.
The target/style truth path and SHA-256 never appear in generation input_images or generation calls.
The prompt contains zero training-source or held-out-source hard-coded clauses.
Every realized generation record conforms to generation-provenance-v1 and its hashes recompute from disk.
Frozen validation covers baseline, pose, composition, and exact text across two unseen source hashes.
Aggregate, worst-case, explicit assertions, and generalization-gap thresholds pass on validation and sealed test.
All generation and judge models, prompts, hashes, and loss components are persisted.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool.
Target/style truth is analysis-and-judge-only and forbidden as a generation input.
Do not open validationManifest before validate-transferability.
Do not open sealedTestManifest before audit-generalization.
Do not modify prior iteration evidence.
Do not compare losses across incompatible judge or prompt-input contracts.
